description: This file is a React component implementing the organizations management UI, including displaying a list of organizations, creating new ones, viewing details, and deleting organizations. It uses UI libraries like @tremor/react and antd and includes hooks and state management for interactions.

classes.name: OrganizationsTable
classes.description: React functional component managing organization list, creation, viewing, and deletion with internal state hooks and UI rendering.

methods.name: fetchOrganizations
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch the list of organizations using an access token and update state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Initiates delete process for an organization by setting state variables.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Performs the delete organization API call and refreshes the list on success.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Closes the delete confirmation modal without performing deletion.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new organization, including transforming form data and invoking API, then refreshes list.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Closes the organization creation modal and resets the form.
